## Waves on a plate

A wave on a plate obeys $$\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial t^2} = c^2 \nabla^2 u$$, written inline.

$$
u_{t+1} = 2u_t - u_{t-1} + c^2 \Delta t^2 \, \nabla^2 u_t
$$

<Demo caption="Strike the plate to start a ring of waves.">
  ![A plate at rest](/blog/webgl-or-how-to-draw-a-single-point-the-hard-way/20f6f3ce-c936-445e-bbde-26365a079ae0.png)
</Demo>

### The step in code

```ts
function step(now: number, before: number, laplacian: number): number {
  return 2 * now - before + 0.25 * laplacian;
}
```

Use `--reload` to start over, and write a brace as \{ or {"{"} and a less-than as \< in text.
